title: CombatTagLite
description: Tags players in combat and blocks listed commands.
body:
# CombatTagLite

Tags players in combat and blocks listed commands.

## Features
- Tags players on PvP damage.
- Blocks commands while tagged.
- Action bar countdown.
- Configurable tag duration.

## Command
- `/combattag status | /combattag reload`

## Permissions
- `combattaglite.use`
- `combattaglite.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
tag-seconds: 15
blocked-commands: [spawn, home]
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
